name_reason: Matches fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (fd2_chapter_19_end). The '19' is a meaningful chapter ID (valid chapters are 01-30), not a Ghidra address remnant -- address is 0x23e39, no hex tail matches the name. Consistent with all 18 sibling chapter-end handlers in chend1.c.
purpose: Chapter 19 dispatch-table end handler: persists party runtime state, shows chapter-end dialog page 3, then advances to the next chapter.
logic_summary: Calls fd2_save_runtime_char_to_template() first (save-up-front, matching binary order), then fd2_display_dialog_scene(data_fd2_current_chapter_text, page=3, 0xa0000, 0x140, 0xcd, 0x4c, 0x4a, 0x13, 1), then INC data_fd2_chapter_current_chapter_id. No char recruited in-handler (龍劍士巴拿羅西亞 joins via an FDFIELD event). In the binary the tail is ADD ESP,0x24; JMP 0x231F2 -- a tail-jump into the shared 'INC current_chapter_id; RET' snippet shared with fd2_chapter_11_end; emitted as a self-contained function (Layer 2 functional equivalence). The PUSH 0x28; CALL __CHK prologue is a Watcom stack-probe artifact, correctly not emitted in source.

returns.semantics: No return value. Dispatched indirectly through the chapter-end handler pointer table (data xref @ 0x51e31); no direct callers.

notes: Trivial handler; src comment block (lines 935-955) already precise and accurate (save-up-front order, tail-jump @ 0x231F2 / Layer 2 equivalence, no in-handler recruit, paired init/post-action handlers). Ghidra plate consistent with refined understanding -- left untouched. Ghidra decompile shows spurious in_stack_* pseudo-args from the __CHK stub call; real signature is void(void), param_count=0. data_fd2_current_chapter_text is the symbol behind PUSH dword ptr [0x53a79] (Ghidra shows _data_fd2_current_chapter_text with fixup-to 0x3a79 comment); src uses data_fd2_current_chapter_text consistent with all siblings.
